title: botrychium australe var. erosum
intro: Botrychium australe var. erosum, commonly known as Slender Lip Fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Botrychium australe var. erosum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
